element_ne.name: Neon

element_na.name: Sodium
element_na.description: Sodium (Na). A soft, silvery alkali metal. Atomic number 11. Essential for biological organisms.

element_mg.name: Magnesium
element_mg.description: Magnesium (Mg). A shiny gray alkaline earth metal. Atomic number 12. Essential for living cells.

element_al.name: Aluminium
element_al.description: Aluminium (Al). A silvery-white, lightweight metal. Atomic number 13. Most abundant metal in Earth crust.

element_si.name: Silicon
element_si.description: Silicon (Si). A hard, brittle crystalline metalloid. Atomic number 14. Widely used in semiconductors and electronics.

element_p.name: Phosphorus
element_p.description: Phosphorus (P). A reactive nonmetal. Atomic number 15. Essential for DNA, RNA, and ATP.

element_s.name: Sulfur
element_s.description: Sulfur (S). A yellow crystalline nonmetal. Atomic number 16. Used in gunpowder and sulfuric acid.

element_cl.name: Chlorine
element_cl.description: Chlorine (Cl). A yellow-green halogen gas. Atomic number 17. Used as a disinfectant and bleach.

element_ar.name: Argon
element_ar.description: Argon (Ar). A colorless, odorless noble gas. Atomic number 18. Most abundant noble gas in Earth atmosphere.

element_k.name: Potassium
element_k.description: Potassium (K). A soft, silvery alkali metal. Atomic number 19. Essential for nerve function and muscle contraction.

element_ca.name: Calcium
element_ca.description: Calcium (Ca). A soft gray alkaline earth metal. Atomic number 20. Essential for bones, teeth, and cellular signaling.

element_sc.name: Scandium
element_sc.description: Scandium (Sc). A silvery-white metallic transition metal. Atomic number 21. Used in aerospace alloys.

element_ti.name: Titanium
element_ti.description: Titanium (Ti). A lustrous transition metal with low density and high strength. Atomic number 22.

element_v.name: Vanadium
element_v.description: Vanadium (V). A hard, silvery-grey transition metal. Atomic number 23. Used in steel alloys.

element_cr.name: Chromium
element_cr.description: Chromium (Cr). A shiny grey transition metal. Atomic number 24. Provides corrosion resistance in stainless steel.

element_mn.name: Manganese
element_mn.description: Manganese (Mn). A hard, brittle silvery transition metal. Atomic number 25. Essential for steel production.

element_fe.name: Iron

element_co.name: Cobalt

element_ni.name: Nickel
element_ni.description: Nickel (Ni). A silvery-white lustrous transition metal. Atomic number 28. Used in stainless steel and batteries.

element_cu.name: Copper
element_cu.description: Copper (Cu). A reddish-brown transition metal. Atomic number 29. Excellent conductor of electricity and heat.

element_zn.name: Zinc
element_zn.description: Zinc (Zn). A bluish-white transition metal. Atomic number 30. Essential for galvanization and biological enzymes.

element_ga.name: Gallium

element_ge.description: Germanium (Ge). A lustrous, hard-brittle metalloid. Atomic number 32. Used in fiber optics and semiconductors.

element_as.name: Arsenic
element_as.description: Arsenic (As). A brittle, steel-gray metalloid. Atomic number 33. Known for its toxicity.

element_se.name: Selenium
element_se.description: Selenium (Se). A nonmetal with reddish color. Atomic number 34. Essential trace element for living organisms.

element_br.name: Bromine

element_kr.name: Krypton
element_kr.description: Krypton (Kr). A colorless noble gas. Atomic number 36. Used in high-performance light bulbs.

element_rb.name: Rubidium
element_rb.description: Rubidium (Rb). A soft, silvery-white alkali metal. Atomic number 37. Highly reactive.

element_sr.name: Strontium
element_sr.description: Strontium (Sr). A soft, silvery alkaline earth metal. Atomic number 38. Used in fireworks for red color.

element_y.name: Yttrium
element_y.description: Yttrium (Y). A silvery-metallic transition metal. Atomic number 39. Used in LEDs and superconductors.

element_zr.name: Zirconium
element_zr.description: Zirconium (Zr). A lustrous gray-white transition metal. Atomic number 40. Used in nuclear reactors.

element_nb.name: Niobium
element_nb.description: Niobium (Nb). A shiny gray transition metal. Atomic number 41. Used in superconducting magnets.

element_mo.name: Molybdenum
